WHILE I SEE VALUE IN SOME PROPERTY RIGHTS FOR LAND, I THINK SOCIETIES SHOULD ENSURE LAND USE SERVES BROADER SOCIAL GOODS AND THAT ACCESS ISN'T PURELY DETERMINED BY WEALTH.
I AGREE IT'S REGRETTABLE WHEN FINANCIAL SPECULATION GENERATES VAST WEALTH WITHOUT CORRESPONDING SOCIAL CONTRIBUTION, THOUGH SOME FINANCIAL SERVICES DO PROVIDE GENUINE VALUE.
I AGREE THAT PROTECTIONISM CAN SOMETIMES BE JUSTIFIED TO PROTECT NASCENT INDUSTRIES, WORKERS, OR STRATEGIC INTERESTS, THOUGH IT CARRIES REAL COSTS.
I STRONGLY DISAGREE—CORPORATIONS OPERATE WITHIN SOCIETIES AND HAVE RESPONSIBILITIES TO WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT BEYOND SHAREHOLDER RETURNS.
I DISAGREE IN MOST DEVELOPED ECONOMIES; PROGRESSIVE TAXATION HELPS FUND PUBLIC GOODS AND REDUCE INEQUALITY THAT CAN HARM SOCIAL COHESION.
I BELIEVE EVERYONE DESERVES QUALITY HEALTHCARE REGARDLESS OF ABILITY TO PAY, THOUGH I RECOGNIZE DEBATES ABOUT WHAT ADDITIONAL SERVICES MARKETS MIGHT PROVIDE.
ABSOLUTELY—GOVERNMENTS SHOULD HOLD BUSINESSES ACCOUNTABLE FOR DELIBERATE DECEPTION, WHICH UNDERMINES FAIR MARKETS AND HARMS CONSUMERS.
I AGREE—GENUINE MARKET COMPETITION REQUIRES ANTITRUST ENFORCEMENT TO PREVENT MONOPOLISTIC CONCENTRATION THAT ULTIMATELY HARMS CONSUMERS AND INNOVATION.
I STRONGLY DISAGREE—I BELIEVE WOMEN SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE DECISIONS ABOUT THEIR OWN BODIES, AND ABORTION ACCESS IS A MATTER OF PERSONAL AUTONOMY AND HEALTHCARE.
I AGREE THAT QUESTIONING AUTHORITY IS HEALTHY AND ESSENTIAL FOR ACCOUNTABILITY, THOUGH THIS DOESN'T MEAN ALL AUTHORITY IS ILLEGITIMATE.
I REJECT PURELY RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE; I BELIEVE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SHOULD FOCUS MORE ON REHABILITATION, RESTITUTION, AND PREVENTING FUTURE HARM.
I DISAGREE—PUBLIC FUNDING FOR ARTS AND CULTURE PROVIDES BROAD SOCIAL BENEFITS THAT MARKETS ALONE WON'T SUSTAIN, ENRICHING SOCIETY BEYOND COMMERCIAL METRICS.
I DISAGREE—COMPULSORY ATTENDANCE HELPS ENSURE CHILDREN RECEIVE EDUCATION AND PROTECTS AGAINST NEGLECT, THOUGH SCHOOLS SHOULD BE ENGAGING PLACES.

I DISAGREE—I THINK OPENNESS ABOUT SEX IS GENERALLY HEALTHY, REDUCING SHAME AND IMPROVING EDUCATION, THOUGH AGE-APPROPRIATE CONTEXTS MATTER.
